obfuscation_indicators: full financial effects cannot be reasonably estimated
risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and well quantified, including revenue declines, impairment charges, liquidity actions, and COVID-19-related costs. Risk is elevated due to the pandemic-driven revenue and earnings deterioration, increased debt-related costs, impairment, and uncertainty around recovery and tax asset realization. Some standard forward-looking language limits precision regarding the duration and ultimate magnitude of risks.
